No more arguing with clients about paperwork; no more phone calls from an impatient boss demanding immediate follow-up. Those details faded as she tended to Max's overgrown underbrush – and he reciprocated by giving her a sloppy, appreciative lick on the wrist.

Back at his owner's place, Mr. Lee chatted animatedly with Lena through their shared gate about garden care tips and whatnot, chuckling wryly regarding Max's 'explorations'.
